# Bundled web assets

The local web interface bundles the following fixed-version assets so Markdown and mathematical
notation render without a CDN or Node build.

| Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Marked | 15.0.12 | MIT |
| DOMPurify | 3.2.6 | Apache-2.0 or MPL-2.0 |
| KaTeX (including auto-render and fonts) | 0.16.22 | MIT |

The upstream package notices and full license texts are available from each package repository.
